no-reader:async-b.title: Nobody reads async target
no-reader:async-b.message: async source publishes to async target, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.
no-reader:async-b.rationale: A topic keeps what's published until its retention ends, whether anything reads it or not. With no consumer group, nothing acts on its messages, and more partitions don't change that.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads async target, then add it and connect async-b to it.

no-reader:labelled-b.title: Nobody reads labelled target
no-reader:labelled-b.message: labelled source sends to labelled target, but nothing consumes it: messages pile up.
no-reader:labelled-b.rationale: A queue with producers and no consumers only grows. Every queue should have a consumer that takes its messages.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads labelled target, then add it and connect labelled-b to it.
